instruction.text: Look at the line graph showing the number of visitors at a zoo and answer the questions.

atoms.a: Which month saw the most visitors?
Which month saw the least visitors?
How many months had more than 40,000 visitors?
What was the total number of visitors in the first three months?

instruction.text: Look at the line graph showing the number of visitors at an aquarium and answer the questions.

atoms.a: How many months had more than 30,000 visitors?
What was the total number of visitors in the last three months?

instruction.text: Now look at this line graph comparing the number of visitors at both attractions and answer the questions.

atoms.a: In which month did both attractions have an equal number of visitors?
In how many months did the zoo have more visitors than the aquarium?
Which attraction was more successful in winter?

hint.text: More than one answer can be correct.

b: ++It was too rainy to go to the zoo.
